title: NetworkConsent
description: network.consent@1 (L24, data and AI by consent, 2026-10-31): one person's choice for one purpose. Nothing a person makes is off-limits to AI or data use by design; each use is off until that person turns it on, here. The record is the proof of what was allowed, by whom, under which wording and when: a choice is turned off by setting revoked_at, never by deleting the row. Stored by OpenVibe.Network (consents, with every change in consent_events), read by a person at GET /api/v1/me/consent and by services through POST /internal/consent/check (capability network.consent.read). A service that cannot reach Network treats every purpose as off.

id.description: The choice's own id (cns_<ULID>). A choice changed later (other kinds, another licence) is a new record; the old one is revoked.

subject.description: Whose choice it is. Only that person (or an account merge or deletion) changes it.

purpose.description: What turning it on allows. ai.train: OpenVibe trains or fine-tunes models on the person's content. data.public: the person's content goes into OpenVibe's open dataset under the licence in options. face.recognize: the person's face is recognised (the features in options; OpenVibe.Vision keeps the encrypted templates). ai.looks: AI text about the person may describe how they look (it lifts the no-looks rule for that person only, never for anyone else in frame). app.data: one named app (client) may use the person's content for the purposes in options.

on.description: Whether the purpose is allowed now: true while the record is active (revoked_at null and expires_at not passed). A service never decides from this field alone; it asks the check.

kinds.description: Which of the person's content it covers. Empty means every kind the purpose applies to. face.recognize and ai.looks take no kinds (they are about the person, not a piece of content).

client.description: The app the choice is for: null means OpenVibe itself; otherwise the OAuth client id of an app the person granted (required for app.data, and only there).

licence.description: data.public only: the licence the person's content is published under.

features.description: face.recognize only: which recognition the person allows (OpenVibe.Vision's features). Empty means none yet.

purposes.description: app.data only: what the app may do with the person's content, as the consent screen showed it.

options.description: What the purpose needs beyond on and kinds. An empty object for ai.train and ai.looks.

text_version.description: The exact wording the person saw when choosing (YYYY-MM-DD.n). A new wording never turns an existing choice on; it may only ask again.

source.description: Where the choice was made: the account page, an app's consent screen, the person's own API call, or OpenVibe.Vision's older face consents moved into Network.

granted_at.description: When the person turned it on.

revoked_at.description: When it was turned off (by the person, by revoking the app, by a merge or by deleting the account), or null while it holds. Use stops on the next check; a model already trained keeps what it learned, and the next dataset release leaves the person's content out.

expires_at.description: When the choice ends by itself (a time-limited grant, or the end of a face purpose), or null for no end.
